geometry_edits.rationale: Align the public threshold with the verified access edge and strengthen the access-side opening.
Broaden the notch so the ground opening reads as a usable public seam rather than a small incision.
Increase vertical extent of the access cut to improve public void presence at the frontage.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent early massing in all four views: one dominant terraced-bent body, with the plan and elevations agreeing enough to avoid the ‘one-view-only’ failure. The parcel is respected as a contained, non-bounding-box-responsive footprint rather than a generic rectangle. The thick blue frontage edge is answered only moderately: the west-side notch and the exposed lower edge suggest an access seam, but the ground response is not yet as legible or generous as the references. The stepped upper silhouette is coherent and capacity-bearing rather than arbitrary, so it scores above average on silhouette resolution, but the section still feels somewhat sculptural rather than fully program-driven. The main weakness is that the public void is present but not yet fully emphatic as usable neighborhood space; a cleaner carve or courtyard would strengthen the access relation and program fit.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Curved upper mass with a clear central void/threshold and strong one-piece reading across views.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much larger and more plural than the candidate; don’t imitate the tower field or multi-building complexity.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Campus-like grouping around a courtyard can preserve neighborhood scale while organizing public open space.
Low-rise elongated massing with courtyard void and site-responsive plan spread supports mixed neighborhood use.
Terraced, bridge-connected low-rise composition with an explicit public courtyard and circulation emphasis.
Interlocking masses with a central void and layered setbacks can support a public mixed-use threshold.

warnings: The blue access edge is not strongly activated; the threshold reads more as a notch than a clearly public ground void.
Section logic is serviceable but still somewhat generic for neighborhood living; a clearer courtyard/void could improve it.
The form is coherent, but the stepped upper mass risks reading as a stylized gesture unless the lower public figure is sharpened.
